demo.title: lp-vault-session.txt
demo.code:
You:   Create and curate a WETH/USDC LP vault on Uniswap V3, Base
Bankr: I verified the Base deployment, WETH/USDC pool, and current vault capability.
       Create the curated vault with your Bankr wallet as direct manager? (yes/no)
You:   yes
Bankr: Vault created and ready for LP deposits. Tx: basescan.org/tx/0x…

You:   Deposit $5,000 into the vault
Bankr: Deposit $5,000 using the reviewed transaction? (yes/no)
You:   yes
Bankr: Deposit confirmed. Tx: basescan.org/tx/0x…

You:   Every hour, review this vault and notify me when a range update is worthwhile.
Bankr: Hourly review automation is active. It checks price, inventory, ranges,
       and tend economics, then reports an actionable recommendation or a
       specific skip reason. It never modifies the curated vault without your
       specific approval.

setup: Set `STEER_RPC_URL` and `STEER_SUBGRAPH_STUDIO_KEY` as secure environment secrets. The rebalance-context helper requires the subgraph key; tend `quote` and `prepare` require `eth_getProof` support from the RPC.

Use the Steer CLI provided by Bankr in `execute_cli`. Bankr owns installation, approved versions, upgrades, and executable resolution. This skill must never install or upgrade the CLI. Run `steer --version` and inspect the required command help and schema before collecting live data. Stop with `CLI_UNAVAILABLE` or `CLI_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED` when the provided CLI cannot satisfy the workflow; keep the same CLI throughout quote and preparation.
Resolve the Bankr EVM wallet address. Pass it as `--account` to account-aware quote and prepare commands so simulation can check the expected signer.

Review CLI stages as JSON: `steer <command> --format json --full-output`. Do not broadcast with the CLI; submit only the unchanged prepared request through `submit_raw_transaction` after specific approval or a valid bounded automation policy.
